results.title: Anil Sharma recalls Nana Patekar bond and their unfulfilled 'Gadar 3' reunion
results.description: Anil Sharma has remembered the late veteran artist, Nana Patekar as the easiest actor to work with after Dharmendra, praising his warmth, simplicity and generosity on film sets. In an interview with Mid-Day, the 'Gadar' director revealed that they had discussed collaborating on 'Gadar 3', a reunion that will now remain unrealised. Patekar died at 75 on October 8, 2026, following a cardiac arrest. Sharma and the veteran actor last worked together on the 2024 film 'Vanvaas.'

results.title: Navratri 2026: What to Prepare on Day 1 Before Kalash Sthapana
results.description: Shardiya Navratri 2026 begins on October 11 with Kalash Sthapana and the worship of Maa Shailputri. Devotees can prepare for the first day by arranging essential puja samagri, cleaning the worship area, preparing traditional bhog and keeping the Goddess's mantra ready. This guide covers the important items, basic preparations and the need to check the locally applicable Ghatasthapana muhurat.
